title.purpose: Screen titles; the large number in a stat tile.

heading.purpose: Panel section headers; the Correct/Incorrect outcome banner.

body.purpose: Default running text — prompts, descriptions, empty states.

label.purpose: Button/chip labels, muted captions and metadata.

mono.purpose: Theme-name line on a stats theme row.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-emphasis action: submit, next puzzle, retry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8B5E34; color: #F7F1E3; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 22px; border: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { opacity: 0.85; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Reversible/secondary action: replay controls, sign out, alternate line.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #8B5E34; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 22px; border: 1px solid #8B5E34; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { opacity: 0.85; outline: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { background: #FFFBF3; color: #7A6349; border: 1px solid #E0CFB4; border-radius: 22px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { opacity: 0.85; outline: none; }

components.name: Chip Selected
components.description: Selected theme/order filter pill — shares the primary button's accent/text pairing.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { background: #8B5E34; color: #F7F1E3; border: 1px solid #8B5E34; border-radius: 22px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Base surface for grouped content — stats blocks, the review outcome card.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #FFFBF3; border: 1px solid #E0CFB4; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; } .ds-panel-heading { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; color: #3B2412; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-panel-body { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: #3B2412; margin: 0; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.description: Bare number-over-caption pair inside a Panel; no border/background of its own.
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-stat-value { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #3B2412; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #7A6349; }

components.name: Theme Progress Row
components.description: Pressable per-theme accuracy row with a threshold-colored progress track (stats screen signature).
components.css: .ds-theme-row { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: #FFFBF3; border: 1px solid #E0CFB4; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-theme-row:hover, .ds-theme-row:focus-visible { opacity: 0.85; outline: none; } .ds-theme-row-header { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-theme-row-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #3B2412; } .ds-theme-row-rate { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #7A6349; } .ds-theme-row-track { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #E0CFB4; margin-top: 8px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-theme-row-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 3px; background: #4C7A3F; } .ds-theme-row-meta { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #7A6349; }

narrative.overview: Atelier is a solo instrument, not a showcase: one person sitting down with their own chess mistakes, the way a luthier sits at a workbench with a single instrument in front of them. The palette is warm, wood-grained, and restrained — a single walnut accent against parchment and ivory, the same materials that build the chessboard itself. Surfaces are flat and hairline-bordered rather than shadowed or glossy: nothing floats, nothing performs. Every panel, chip, and button is cut from the same plain stock, in service of the board, which is the one place the app allows itself a flourish (a diagonal wood-grain gradient on every square). The app is deliberately light-only — no dark mode, no per-OS Material/Cupertino divergence — because it is one tool for one craftsperson, tuned once rather than adapted per visitor. Typography stays on the system default everywhere; the only "custom" typographic gesture is a small monospace-flavored label role reserved for theme names and notation-adjacent text.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated accent (Walnut Brown) on an otherwise warm-neutral palette — sparse, not omnipresent.
Flat, hairline-bordered surfaces; no drop shadows anywhere in the system.
System font only, no custom typeface.
Light-only; no dark-mode variant exists or is planned.
The chessboard is the signature component: diagonal (155°) wood-grain gradients per square, animated piece travel, and overlay colors that deliberately reuse the UI's own semantic colors.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Walnut Brown is the only saturated color that isn't semantic (success/error). It appears on primary actions, selection state, and the single most actionable number on a stats surface (e.g. Stats' "Dues" tile) — never as decoration or background fill, and never on more than one number at a time.

rules.name: The Wood Grain Rule
rules.body: Every board square is a 155°-angled two-stop linear gradient, not a flat fill: light squares run #E3C79A → #D2AD76, dark squares run #8B5E34 → #6E4623. Board overlays (selected square, legal-move markers, last-move highlight) are translucent reuses of Moss Green, Espresso, and a dedicated amber — the board never introduces a color the rest of the UI doesn't already use.

rules.name: The No-Custom-Face Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a font family. Every text role is a size/weight variation on the platform system font.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow/elevation is used on any component. A component reads as "raised" only through its hairline border and the surface/background tonal contrast — never through a shadow.

dos: Do keep Walnut Brown to primary actions and selection state — it stays legible as "the one thing to press" precisely because it's rare (The One Accent Rule).
Do build new surfaces from the existing primitives (Screen, AppText, Panel, Button, Chip, Toggle) in src/components/ui.tsx rather than one-off styling.
Do use hairline borders + tonal surface steps for any new "raised" element, never a shadow.
Do reuse Moss Green / Burnt Terracotta for any new success/error state rather than introducing a new semantic color.
donts: Don't add a dark-mode variant or branch on system color scheme — userInterfaceStyle is deliberately light.
Don't add box-shadow/elevation styling anywhere; depth comes from borders and tone only (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
Don't introduce a custom font family or a second accent color — the palette is deliberately one accent plus two semantic colors.
Don't give the board a color the rest of the UI doesn't already use — new board overlays should reuse an existing token (The Wood Grain Rule).
